intro: Combobox combines a trigger button with a searchable dropdown list. Use it when option lists are too long to scan at a glance, or when users need to type to filter before picking.
useCases: Assign owners from long user lists in project management tools.
Filter and select tags, labels, or categories.
Country and timezone pickers in onboarding flows.
Multi-value selection for filter panels and dashboards.

faqs.question: How is Combobox different from Select?
faqs.answer: Combobox adds a search input inside the dropdown panel so users can type to filter options in real time. Select is a plain listbox with no filtering.

faqs.question: Does Combobox support multiple selection?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set multiple on the root Combobox and the panel stays open after each pick. Deselect by clicking a selected item again.

faqs.question: Is Combobox accessible by default?
faqs.answer: The search input has role combobox, the list has role listbox, and items have role option. Keyboard navigation with ArrowDown/Up, Enter, and Escape is built in.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
A compound component split into trigger, content panel, search input, list, items, and an empty state.

The search input filters visible items client-side matching on value and label text.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body:
Wrap with Combobox for context. Place ComboboxTrigger (with ComboboxValue) and ComboboxContent (with ComboboxSearch, ComboboxList, and ComboboxItem) as children.

All sub-components accept className and data-slot for easy slot-level targeting.

sections.heading: Common use cases
sections.body: Comboboxes are ideal for situations where users need to select from a large list of options, such as country selectors, timezone pickers, user assignment dropdowns in project management tools, or multi-select tag and label inputs.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body:
The search input carries role combobox and aria-controls pointing to the listbox. Active item is tracked via aria-activedescendant. Disabled items are marked aria-disabled and ignored by keyboard and pointer.

Test with keyboard-only flows and screen readers when integrating.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body:
Import from the ui/combobox subpath entry. Mark the parent subtree as a Client Component when using onChange or controlled value.

Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL so canonical and Open Graph URLs resolve correctly on deploy.
